name: ARDEX (ASEAN)
description: ASEAN Regional Disaster Emergency Response Simulation Exercise (ARDEX) — biennial full-scale disaster response exercise involving all ASEAN member states. Simulates large-scale natural disasters (earthquakes, tsunamis, typhoons) requiring coordinated multi-national humanitarian response, testing the ASEAN Agreement on Disaster Management and Emergency Response (AADMER).
domain: regional disaster response, humanitarian coordination, multi-national emergency management
difficulty_level: senior-level (national and regional emergency management officials)
reputation: authoritative regional standard; key mechanism for ASEAN disaster preparedness and response capacity building
notes: Biennial exercise cycle. Hosted by rotating ASEAN member states. Tests ASEAN's regional disaster response mechanisms including military asset deployment, humanitarian logistics, and diplomatic coordination.

institutions: ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on Disaster Management (AHA Centre)
